scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/rewrite-dist-import-specifiers.mjs
scripts.build:test: node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs dist-test && node scripts/build-test.mjs && node scripts/rewrite-test-import-specifiers.mjs
scripts.lint: biome check src test scripts docs README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json tsconfig.test.json --files-ignore-unknown=true
scripts.test:node: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/test/runtime/node.test.js
scripts.test:bun: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun test test/runtime/bun.test.ts; elif [ -n "$CI" ]; then echo 'error: bun is required in CI' >&2; exit 1; else echo 'skip: bun not installed'; fi
scripts.test:all: npm run test:node && npm run test:deno && npm run test:bun && npm run test:browser && npm run test:workers && npm run check:pack
